caption: Products and tokens on the Content API tab of a subscriber
preconditions: Subscriber 'Content API client' (seeded by seed.py, SUBSCRIBERS) has the 'General news' product (type both) in api_products and no Content API token yet; the steps generate one. 'Subscriber 1' is not used here: it carries a seeded token for defining-publishing-in-superdesk/subscriber-content-api
steps: Open #/settings/publish and wait for [data-test-id="subscriber-item"] to be visible
cleanup: Click the 'Cancel' button in the open modal
notes: Wizard step 'Content API' in scripts/apps/publish/views/subscribers.html: Products (sd-meta-terms, class subscriber-products, lists products of type API or Both), Authentication Token list with expiry and Revoke/Copy icons, 'Expire in' select (default 1 week) and 'Generate token' button. Generate token saves a subscriber_token on the server at once, without the Save button, so the token stays after Cancel; restore the snapshot to remove it. Mask the token value so a real token string is not published. Badges: 1 = Products, 2 = token row.

caption: Production API keys in Settings
preconditions: Logged in user has the auth_server_clients privilege (admin has all)
Two Production API keys exist: 'Mobile reporting app' (ARCHIVE_READ, DESKS_READ) and 'Invoicing system' (USERS_READ), seeded by seed.py (API_KEYS)
steps: Open #/settings/production-api-keys and wait for [data-test-id="list-page--items"] to be visible
notes: Settings page 'Production API' (scripts/apps/production-api-keys). Each row (data-test-id production-api-keys) shows the name, 'Last updated' and 'Created' dates, with Edit (pencil) and Delete (bin) icons. The list has no filter, sort or item count. The Settings left menu should be visible with 'Production API' active in the Workflow group.

caption: A new key right after saving: copy the Client Secret now
preconditions: Logged in user has the auth_server_clients privilege (admin has all)
No key named 'Meridian mobile app' exists (names must be unique, case-insensitive)
steps: Open #/settings/production-api-keys and wait for [data-test-id="list-page--items"] to be visible
notes: Flow from e2e/client/playwright/production-api-keys.spec.ts. Form config scripts/apps/production-api-keys/config.ts: Name, Scopes (Archive, Desks, Users, Contacts, Planning, Events, Assignments, Content lists), a warning alert about the one-time secret, and a 'Credentials' group with Client ID and Client Secret (CopyableTextBox, info text 'Copy this now, you won't be able to access it again.'). After save the panel switches to view mode and shows both values. The highlight should be a box around the whole Client Secret field; the CopyableTextBox has no test id, so resolve it from its label text and widen if needed. The secret value is masked: it is a working credential on whichever instance the shot was taken, the key stays in the database until the snapshot is restored, and the guide image would otherwise carry it. Closing asks 'Close this panel?' with 'Close anyway' / 'Go back' (data-test-id confirm-copy); the cleanup closes it.
